Enhanced Description: Pneumatic single post lifter with stirrers is a configured variant within the PNEUMATIC STIRRER platform. Final ratio, pressure, output, heating, controls and accessories depend on the selected application.

PNEUMATIC
STIRRER

CONSTRUCTIONS
All wetted parts are made of stainless steel
Electrical motors are IS standard (IP55 rated)
Optional small Laboratory application stirrer with
pheumatic motors
Pneumatic actuated hoisting units for standard drum
pails available separately
STIRRER CLASSIFICATIONS
Hand held (for low viscous, lab applications)
Pneumatic motor driven stirrer with single post hoist
for 20/25/50 Itr pail. (automated lifting of stirrer)
Electrically driven stirrer on twin post hoist 20/50/200 Itr
pails. (for high viscous materials)
AVAILABLE TURBINE BLADE SIZES
TB-70 (best suited for hand held stirrer for smaller pails)
TB-110 (Medium duty turbine suited to fit on tank covers)
TB-180 (Heavy duty turbine suited for 200 Ltr hoist)
TURBINE STIRRER SERIES
Rotary mixing stirrer driven by flameproof or EX-certified electric motor.
Efficient crushing and mixing of the material due to its unique blade construction.
Used for blending of all kinds of liquid and semi-solid products.
Eliminate any vortex effect, consequently avoiding any inclusion of air bubbles.
Especially suitable in dissolving, dispersing and crushing of particulates.
Mounting options available on a pneumatic hoist (for 20/200 Itr pail) for
ease of operation and can be used to mix varying quantity of material in
standard pails.

Pneumatic motor driven stirrer with single post hoist
for 20/25/50 Itr pail. (automated lifting of stirrer)
Electrically driven stirrer on twin post hoist 20/50/200 Itr
pails. (for high viscous materials)
AVAILABLE TURBINE BLADE SIZES
TB-70 (best suited for hand held stirrer for smaller pails)
TB-110 (Medium duty turbine suited to fit on tank covers)
TB-180 (Heavy duty turbine suited for 200 Ltr hoist)
TURBINE STIRRER SERIES
Rotary mixing stirrer driven by flameproof or EX-certified electric motor.
Efficient crushing and mixing of the material due to its unique blade construction.
Used for blending of all kinds of liquid and semi-solid products.
Eliminate any vortex effect, consequently avoiding any inclusion of air bubbles.
Especially suitable in dissolving, dispersing and crushing of particulates.
Mounting options available on a pneumatic hoist (for 20/200 Itr pail) for
ease of operation and can be used to mix varying quantity of material in
standard pails.

Hand held (for low viscous, lab applications)
Pneumatic motor driven stirrer with single post hoist
for 20/25/50 Itr pail. (automated lifting of stirrer)
Electrically driven stirrer on twin post hoist 20/50/200 Itr
pails. (for high viscous materials)

Rotary mixing stirrer driven by flameproof or EX-certified electric motor.
Efficient crushing and mixing of the material due to its unique blade construction.
Used for blending of all kinds of liquid and semi-solid products.
Eliminate any vortex effect, consequently avoiding any inclusion of air bubbles.
Especially suitable in dissolving, dispersing and crushing of particulates.
Mounting options available on a pneumatic hoist (for 20/200 Itr pail) for
ease of operation and can be used to mix varying quantity of material in
standard pails.

TB-70 (best suited for hand held stirrer for smaller pails)
TB-110 (Medium duty turbine suited to fit on tank covers)
TB-180 (Heavy duty turbine suited for 200 Ltr hoist)

Efficient crushing and mixing of the material due to its unique blade construction.
Used for blending of all kinds of liquid and semi-solid products.
Eliminate any vortex effect, consequently avoiding any inclusion of air bubbles.
Especially suitable in dissolving, dispersing and crushing of particulates.
Mounting options available on a pneumatic hoist (for 20/200 Itr pail) for
ease of operation and can be used to mix varying quantity of material in
standard pails.
